title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for f in terms of r.

title: Flux Ratio Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the ratio of luminous fluxes correctly using the given equations.

title: Solid Angle Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the solid angle subtended by the sun.

title: Use of Lens Parameters
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the lens radius and focal length in the calculations.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or missing factors in the equations.

title: Transparency Assumption
description: Optional Criteria: The student should note the assumption of lens transparency being unity.

title: Limiting Case Discussion
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss limiting cases or implications of the derived result.
